description: Use this when a buyer asks to browse one seller's public catalog or one public list. Requires sellerSlug, and can filter by listId, listTitle, cultivar, color, price, photos, hybridizer, parentage, or year. Returns only public listings.

cursor.description: Last seen row id from nextCursor. Keep the same filters and pass this cursor to continue paging.

hasPhoto.description: When true, only listings with uploaded listing photos.

hasPrice.description: When true, only listings with a positive public price.

hybridizer.description: Hybridizer text from the linked cultivar record.

listId.description: Only listings that belong to this public list id.

listTitle.description: Only listings in a public list with this title text.

parentage.description: Parentage text from the linked cultivar record.

q.description: Broad public listing search across listing title, description, cultivar name, hybridizer, color, and parentage.

sellerSlug.description: Public seller slug or user id.

year.description: Cultivar registration or introduction year text.

name: daylily.list_public_listings
title: List Public Listings
